author: reek
body: Dungeon progression and QA gates. A clan can't just drop Diablo into their dungeon on day one. They start in Tristram - a few shamans in a small room. They playtest it themselves, earn revenue, unlock the next tier, and build up. The clan IS the QA team on their own creation.

author: reek
body: Every floor must be cleared by the clan before it goes public. Every monster must be defeated by internal testers. Every loot drop must be verified as achievable. The dungeon grows organically from what the clan can actually build, fund, and prove works.

author: reek
body: The progression mirrors Diablo 1: catacombs first, then caves, then hell. You earn your way to the boss. The clan earns their way to spawning the boss.
